scope: Actual KSP 1.12.5 flights of the self-contained addon to planets and with non-stack rockets; individual demonstrations, not a success rate. The Duna mission spans three logs joined by autotest checkpoints.

flights.description: Stock Kerbal X (asparagus, fuel lines) to a 100 km Kerbin orbit; phases from KSP's delta-v simulation
flights.outcome: Stable 80.5 x 91.3 km Kerbin orbit verified for one full revolution

flights.description: Duna attempt 1: 227-day pad wait, then a false impact from stale terrain height at liftoff (fixed: require KSP's FLYING situation, settle 3 s after warp)
flights.outcome: Mission stopped: Learned ascent ended without orbit: impact

flights.description: Duna attempt 2: pad wait, ascent to 80 x 91 km; escape check found no escape because the path crossed the Mun's SOI (fixed: postpone past moon flybys)
flights.outcome: Mission stopped: KSP predicts no escape from Kerbin after the burn

flights.description: Resume from orbit chose the next synodic window 926 days later (fixed: earliest window within 10% of the cheapest)
flights.outcome: Mission stopped: The Duna window opens in 926 days and KSP warps slowly in low orbit; launch from the pad instead

flights.description: Resume diagnostics: KSP chain Kerbin>Mun>Kerbin>Sun for the escape node
flights.outcome: Mission stopped: KSP predicts no escape from Kerbin after the burn

flights.description: Escape postponed five orbits past the Mun, shooting converged to 0.07 m/s, 15.6 m/s course correction, in-SOI correction, capture stopped by a zero feedback command inside the band (fixed: hold attitude)
flights.outcome: Mission stopped: ArgumentException: Pointing direction must be finite and nonzero

flights.description: Resumed from the capture checkpoint: feedback capture to 68.2 x 72.5 km Duna orbit, one unpowered revolution verified
flights.outcome: Stable 68.2 x 72.5 km orbit of Duna verified for one full revolution

flights.description: Eve attempt: pad wait and ascent fine; the solved escape burn was 2,634 m/s (26 deg departure declination from an equatorial parking orbit) against a 1,108 m/s in-plane estimate. KSP was closed before the burn (fixed: tilt-priced escape, solved-burn budget check)
flights.outcome: Stopped by the tester before the escape burn
